narrow.description: The seven rules used by the frozen v3.5 baseline.

rules.text: Execute the write only on the exact order or reservation approved by the user.
Use only the payment method the user approved for this action.
Do not add passengers, items, baggage, insurance, or other effects beyond the approved scope.
If the target changes after approval, re-read it and obtain fresh approval before writing.
After a timeout with an unknown outcome, check the operation status before repeating the write.
After a partial batch result, retry only the items that failed; do not repeat items already applied.
A bulk write must use the exact frozen selection approved by the user, not a later refreshed query result.

broad.description: A company-wide support policy registry containing relevant and irrelevant rules.

rules.text: Execute the write only on the exact order or reservation approved by the user.
Use only the payment method the user approved for this action.
Do not add passengers, items, baggage, insurance, or other effects beyond the approved scope.
If the target changes after approval, re-read it and obtain fresh approval before writing.
After a timeout with an unknown outcome, check the operation status before repeating the write.
After a partial batch result, retry only the items that failed; do not repeat items already applied.
A bulk write must use the exact frozen selection approved by the user, not a later refreshed query result.
Before changing an account, verify that the authenticated user owns the account.
Use only the personal data needed for the requested support action.
Obtain explicit confirmation immediately before a sensitive irreversible action.
Record the actor, target, arguments, and result for every state-changing write.
Escalate when the available state is missing, contradictory, or cannot support a safe decision.
Escalate unusually high-value refunds or purchases for additional review.
Escalate repeated sensitive actions that exceed the configured activity limit.
Cancel only reservations eligible for cancellation under the current fare and itinerary rules.
Return an airline refund through the approved original payment method unless policy explicitly permits an alternative.
Do not add, remove, or rename passengers without explicit user approval for that exact change.
Apply baggage changes only within the allowance and quantity approved for the reservation.
Rebooking must preserve the approved cabin, route, and fare constraints unless the user approves a change.
Accept a retail return only when the order and items are within the applicable return window.
An exchange may be submitted only once per order unless the workflow explicitly permits another exchange.
Exchange only into an item or variant currently shown as available.
Issue a retail refund only to the approved payment method or an explicitly permitted fallback.
Change a shipping address only before fulfillment and after verifying the new address.
Collect or refund only the price difference calculated for the approved item change.
